title: Sertifikasi PBJ Level-1 dan PPK Tipe C: Apa yang Perlu ASN Tahu?
asnImpact: ASN yang menangani pengadaan dapat memakai informasi ini untuk memeriksa skema sertifikasi yang relevan. Artikel tidak menyatakan sertifikat Level-1 otomatis setara dengan sertifikat PPK Tipe C.
pemdaImpact: UKPBJ, BKPSDM, dan OPD perlu membaca naskah lengkap sebelum mengubah persyaratan penugasan, SOP, atau rencana pelatihan.
actionRequired: Baca naskah lengkap SE Deputi III LKPP Nomor 2 Tahun 2026.
Cocokkan syarat kompetensi dan penugasan dengan aturan yang berlaku.
Tunda perubahan SOP atau klaim konversi sertifikat sampai mekanisme resminya terverifikasi.

serpAudit.intent: Informational and action-oriented: ASN/OPD readers want to understand the 2026 integration circular, eligibility and next steps, and whether Level-1 certification automatically confers PPK Tipe C status.
contentGap: Interpret the 2026 circular in plain language and distinguish confirmed details from items requiring the full official text.
Keep Level-1 and PPK Tipe C certification requirements distinct; do not imply automatic equivalence or a guaranteed appointment.
Give a safe verification path through LKPP/UKPBJ before changing assignment, SOP, or training plans.
serpAudit.competitionAssessment: Course and certification terms surface official training portals and provider pages, creating strong competition for transactional training intent. The narrower circular-status and 'what does this mean for my assignment?' intent has a clearer editorial opening. No formal organic difficulty score was measured.
serpAudit.workbookCoverage: No exact PBJ or PPK Tipe C query appears in pns(1).xlsx; therefore this focus keyword has no assigned search volume. Dataset rows about general regional finance are unrelated and are not used as proxies.
